<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Six tasks, one coder. The table is pure (routes.rs); regeneration rides the existing directory writer commit; delivery is one held FYI from pij-bg per trigger (assign, compact control, revive) and the routes verb on demand; changed rows go as one held FYI to the project prime. Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon (crates/daemon/tests/directory_http.rs pattern). No new launch, timer or poll.
